provenance: Real gemini-4-argon output, 2026-10-17. Replayed fixtures, not a fresh cloud call.

plan.intent: Explore a peaceful space scene with two talking planets, Luma the violet moon and Rumi the amber ringed planet, where tapping either planet glides it gently closer without overlapping the other and tapping it again sends it back home, with no score, timer, quiz, or ending.
controls: Tap Luma to glide her gently close, and tap her again to send her back to her home spot.
Tap Rumi to glide him gently close, and tap him again to send him back to his home spot.
requirements: Keep Luma at her home position (4.2, 4.5) and Rumi at his home position (11.8, 4.5) in zero-gravity space with enough separation so their bodies never overlap.
When Luma is tapped at her home spot, glide her gently to a closer position at least 0.8 m from home and bring her to rest without overlapping Rumi.
When Luma is tapped a second time while close, glide her gently back to her home position at (4.2, 4.5) and bring her to rest.
When Rumi is tapped at his home spot, glide him gently to a closer position at least 0.8 m from home and bring him to rest without overlapping Luma.
When Rumi is tapped a second time while close, glide him gently back to his home position at (11.8, 4.5) and bring him to rest.
Do not include any score changes, timers, quiz questions, or win/lose endings while moving between the two planets.

character.name: Rumi

character.greeting: Hi there! I am Rumi! Tap me to bring me close or send me home, and ask me all about my shiny rings!

then.text: Luma glides gently through space when you call!

narration.intro: Meet Luma the violet moon and Rumi the amber ringed planet! Their playful faces, cozy sizes, and close spots are make-believe and not to scale. Tap either friend to glide them close or send them home, and ask them anything!
